Bundle publication now additionally compares the accepted cache-entry object captured before build. A different build publishing during the solve cannot be overwritten by its late completion. This is conservative compare-and-swap, not a total chronology ordering: if older work publishes first, newer concurrent build can remain uncached until next request. Fact-stamp validation prevents wrong cached answers.
